main.description: Record that the caller accepted the beta terms in force for their account, with the exact wording they were shown. The dashboard calls it from the terms screen after sign-in. Accepting terms already accepted records nothing new. Each acceptance is kept, append-only. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

termsVersion.description: The terms the caller accepted, as getTerms reported them. Anything but the terms in force is refused (TermsOutdated).

textVersion.description: The version of the wording the caller was shown, chosen by the client.

text.description: The exact wording the caller accepted.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per acceptance and resends on every retry of it.

accepted.description: Always true: the caller has now accepted termsVersion.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: termsVersion, textVersion, text or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a customer nor staff, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: TermsRequired
errors.description: The wording or its version is blank.

errors.name: TermsOutdated
errors.description: termsVersion is not the terms in force: the client is showing old terms, and should read getTerms again.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
